id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Ugh... O god of fire. Why did You give such a trial to Miko...?
"...We want to go to the volcano to slay the dragon. Could you give us the mountain gate key?
"...Now that Miko is dead, I have no choice but to ask you. Please take this.
"Now we can go to the volcano... Come on, brother, hurry!
"Before you slay the dragon... please read this and know the truth...
"There seems to be more. Let's read to the end.
I searched desperately for a way to restore Ryu, and at last I found one.
"A mother chooses a painful path for her child. Miko must have struggled and suffered.
"With that magic mirror, perhaps Ryu's curse could have been lifted. But...
"...The magic mirror was eaten by the dragon along with Miko. Ryu's curse can't be lifted now...
"To devour the mother who gave up everything to save him! That is no longer Ryu.
"It is merely an evil dragon that eats people to satisfy its own appetite! Please slay that dragon...!
"Brother... let's go! I'll wait ahead in front of the mountain gate on the western path!"
